description: Details for one Walt Disney World attraction (height requirement, land, thrill level, Lightning Lane tier) plus its recent wait-time history and downtime. Takes an attraction slug, e.g. "space-mountain". For a Disneyland Resort attraction pass resort "dlr" (e.g. slug "space-mountain" with resort "dlr"): it returns that attraction's catalog details, with wait history only where SupaPark has recorded it.

resort.description: Resort: "wdw" (Walt Disney World, the default) or "dlr" (Disneyland Resort). Slugs repeat across resorts (Space Mountain is at both).

name: get_attraction_details
title: Attraction details and wait history
